title: How Rekonise works - Rekonise
textSample: Rekonise How it works Sign in Sign up free HOW IT WORKS Turn every link you share into growth. Add an unlock step to anything you share. Your audience watches, follows, joins, or signs up, and your content unlocks for them automatically. Three steps. About a minute. 01 / CREATE Build a link Paste a URL, upload a file, or write a snippet. Pick the social actions visitors need to complete (follow, subscribe, join, like) and publish. 02 / SHARE Drop it anywhere Put your Rekonise link in your bio, tweet, video description, or group chat. Anyone who clicks lands on a clean unlock page. No account required. 03 / GROW Watch it work As visitors complete the steps, your channels grow on autopilot. Your dashboard shows exactly which links convert and where the traffic comes from. Who uses Rekonise? Anyone who shares a link and wants something in return. play_circle YouTubers Turn video description links into subscribers. Drop a "free preset pack" link, require viewers to subscribe + join Discord to unlock. sports_esports Game creators & modders Distribute scripts, mods, and assets through a single link. Require Discord joins or YouTube subscribes, so your community grows every time someone shares your work. mark_email_read Newsletter & list builders Capture emails as part of the unlock. Anyone who wants your free download joins your list. No extra signup form to drop off on. music_note Musicians & podcasters Gate exclusive tracks behind Spotify follows or Instagram subs. Casual listeners become fans before they hear the next drop. What makes Rekonise different No account for your viewers They click your link, complete the actions, and the content unlocks. Zero signup friction on their end means more of your traffic actually converts. Real analytics, not vanity metrics See conversion rate per link, country and device breakdowns, traffic sources, and top-performing actions. Make decisions on data, not guesses. Free forever for the basics Build as many links as you want without a card. Upgrade to Pro only when you need a year of analytics, custom branding, or ad-free pages for your audience. Built for platform changes Every supported platform (YouTube, X, Discord, Spotify, TikTok, and more) is actively monitored. When an API changes, we ship a fix fast so your links keep converting. Common questions Everything visitors and creators tend to ask. Do my viewers need a Rekonise account to unlock content? How do you verify the actions are actually completed? What kinds of content can I gate behind a link? Will my audience get spammed? What happens if a platform changes their API? Can I see who clicked but didn't complete the steps? Ready to turn traffic into growth? Build a link in under a minute. Free forever for the basics. Build your first link Gate any link behind a social action.
